peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.6% below its local comparables; 42 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,080,000 ($1,402 psf, 742–904 sq ft; 14 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,483 psf (range $1,133–1,702); 5.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $62,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,710,000 ($1,448 psf, 1,087–1,227 sq ft; 6 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,504 psf (range $1,233–1,773); 3.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $66,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Pasir Ris MRT about 650 m, Tampines MRT about 1,770 m; closer than 49 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Elias Park Primary School about 360 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 550 m), more than 27 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Tampines North Hawker Centre about 830 m; nearest park Pasir Ris Park about 650 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Tampines North MRT about 470 m (LTA target 2030) and Elias MRT about 1,060 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Parktown Residence, 73 new sales, about 830 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 32 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 718 new sales and 481 resales (1,199 purchases); new sales were 59.9% of these purchases. Subsales (25) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 481 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 76 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 481 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 444 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+8.3%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
